title: Enable Flink checkpointing
body: Configure Flink checkpoints with persistent storage and verify recovery after restart. Acceptance: checkpoints enabled, recovery tested, documentation added.

title: Implement Flink savepoint strategy
body: Document and test savepoint creation and restore procedures for upgrades. Acceptance: savepoint workflow validated.

title: Add Kafka consumer lag monitoring
body: Implement Kafka consumer lag visibility and dashboard. Acceptance: lag metrics available and alert threshold defined.

title: Modularize Kafka-Flink-IoTDB pipeline
body: Refactor pipeline into source, processing, and sink modules with clear interfaces. Acceptance: modules separated and independently testable.

title: Implement Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)
body: Route malformed or failed events to Kafka DLQ. Acceptance: failed records captured and visible.

title: Add schema validation
body: Validate incoming events against schema before processing. Acceptance: invalid events rejected and logged.

title: Add end-to-end integration tests
body: Create automated tests covering Kafka → Flink → IoTDB flow. Acceptance: integration tests run in CI.

title: Expand test coverage to 70%
body: Increase unit and integration coverage across core modules. Acceptance: 70%+ coverage on critical paths.

title: Add Prometheus metrics
body: Expose application and infrastructure metrics for monitoring. Acceptance: Prometheus scraping configured.

title: Add OpenTelemetry tracing
body: Implement distributed tracing across pipeline components. Acceptance: traces visible end-to-end.

title: Implement centralized logging
body: Aggregate logs for Kafka, Flink, IoTDB, and application services. Acceptance: searchable centralized logs.

title: Build KPI aggregation pipeline
body: Create derived KPI metrics such as utilization, throughput, and OEE. Acceptance: KPIs available in Grafana.

title: Implement anomaly detection
body: Detect abnormal machine behavior using statistical or ML techniques. Acceptance: anomalies generated and stored.

title: Integrate alert workflow
body: Connect anomaly detection and Grafana alerts to workflow actions. Acceptance: alerts trigger workflow and acknowledgement process.

title: Deploy on Kubernetes
body: Create Kubernetes manifests or Helm charts for deployment. Acceptance: successful deployment on K8s cluster.

title: Expand Terraform infrastructure
body: Extend Terraform modules beyond staging to support repeatable environments. Acceptance: dev/staging environments provisionable.

title: Disaster recovery testing
body: Define backup and restore procedures and execute recovery drills. Acceptance: recovery process documented and tested.
